notes.title: v1.1.0 Update
notes.content:
* The game's Rendering Method has been changed from "Forward+" to "Compatibility", which has solved the problem of possible lagging on some old devices.
* A "Special Effect Switch Button" has been added to the scene of passing the game, so that old devices can timely turn off the special effects to improve performance.

notes.title: v1.0.4 Update
notes.content:
* You can now click the keyboard - / + button to resize the window.
* Fixed an issue where some buttons might flicker when the mouse hovers over them.
